title: Trust Center
not_allowed: Only admins and managers can manage the trust center.
load_error: Could not load the trust center: {message}

documents.heading: Documents
documents.unpublish_body: Visitors will no longer see this document. You can publish it again later.
documents.remove_body: This removes it from the trust center.

status.draft_in_progress: Draft v{draft} in progress, visitors see v{version}

picker.title: Publish document
picker.cannot_no_approved_version: No approved version yet. Get the document approved before publishing.

settings.enabled_help: When on, the trust center page can be opened by anyone on the internet.
settings.enable_body: Anything published will be visible to anyone on the internet.
settings.overview_no_approved: This document has no approved version yet. The page leaves the overview out until it is approved.
settings.contact_help: Where visitors report security issues (an email address or a link).
settings.default_level_help: The level a newly published document starts with.
settings.domains_help: People with an email address at these domains cannot sign in. One domain per line. Visitors already signed in keep access until their session ends; end it from the Visitors tab.
settings.domains_default_note: Using the built-in list of personal email providers.
settings.domains_error: Check the domain list: each entry must be a domain such as example.com, and there can be at most 500.
settings.privacy_help: Shown to people who ask for a sign-in link. Leave empty for none.
settings.privacy_error: Enter a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
settings.nda_setup_help: Creates a draft document with a placeholder text. Write the text, send it for review, and choose it here once it is approved.
settings.nda_setup_no_folder: There is no folder yet. Create a folder on the Documents page first.
settings.nda_setup_done: Created {title}. Write the NDA, send it for review, and choose it here once it is approved.
settings.nda_pick_warning: This document has no approved version yet: once saved, gated items are locked for every visitor until it is approved.
settings.nda_status_none: No NDA set: gated items only need sign-in.
settings.nda_unavailable_not_approved: The NDA has no approved version: gated items are locked for every visitor.
settings.nda_unavailable_retired: The NDA document is retired: gated items are locked for every visitor.
settings.nda_unavailable_deleted: The NDA document was deleted: gated items are locked for every visitor.
settings.nda_unavailable_error: The NDA document cannot be read: gated items are locked for every visitor.
settings.nda_skip_help: One domain per line. example.com matches only that domain; *.example.com matches its subdomains, not example.com itself. Visitors at these domains skip the NDA (their email is verified at sign-in).
settings.nda_skip_error: Check the skip list: each entry must be a domain such as example.com or *.example.com, and there can be at most 500.

preview.banner: Preview: this is what visitors see
preview.off: The trust center is off; visitors currently see nothing.
preview.back: Back to the trust center manager

visitors.heading: Visitors
visitors.empty: No visitors have signed in yet.
visitors.revoke_title: Ends all of this person's sessions. They can sign in again with a new link.
visitors.block_title: Blocks this person from signing in and ends all their sessions.
visitors.unblock_title: Lets this person sign in again. Their old sessions stay ended.

warnings.email_not_configured: Email is not configured: visitors cannot sign in. Gated documents show the security contact instead.
warnings.sign_in_paused: Sign-in emails are paused: the hourly limit was reached. They resume at {time}.
warnings.overview_withheld: The overview document is published as gated or restricted, so visitors see no overview.

certifications.heading: Certifications and reports
certifications.delete_body: This deletes the certification and its file. It cannot be undone.
certifications.unpublish_body: Visitors will no longer see it. You can publish it again later.
certifications.f_file: File (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 50 MB)
certifications.err_label_too_long: Name must be 200 characters or fewer
certifications.err_url_invalid: Enter a full http:// or https:// address
certifications.err_file_too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB
certifications.err_file_type: Only PDF, PNG or JPEG files are accepted
certifications.err_dates_order: Valid from must not be after valid until

subprocessors.heading: Subprocessors
subprocessors.no_candidates: Only suppliers with data access that are not terminated can be listed.
subprocessors.details_missing: No public details yet: edit the supplier to add purpose, location and data categories
subprocessors.still_ineligible: It cannot be published again yet ({reason}).
subprocessors.unpublish_body: Visitors will no longer see it. You can publish it again later.
subprocessors.err_ineligible: This supplier cannot be published as a subprocessor ({reason}).
